name: Snooker 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Snooker is a cue sport played with 15 red balls, six colored balls, and one white cue ball. At the start of the game, the red balls are arranged in a triangle, the colored balls are placed on their marked spots, and the cue ball begins inside the D, the half-moon area used for the opening break.
